## Day 1: Health Facilities in Somalia

Public health facilities per 100,000 people in Somalia. Using the WHO health facilities data for Somalia. only about 4 public health facilities are available for every 100,000 people.

```{r}
#| label: day01-setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(geosom)
library(patchwork)
library(ragg)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

## Palette and theme ----
# WFP colours, softened (less saturated) for a flat, minimal look
tint   <- \(col, amount) colorRampPalette(c(col, "white"))(101)[round(amount * 100) + 1]
soften <- \(col, desat = 0.3, lighten = 0.12) {
  hsv <- rgb2hsv(col2rgb(col))
  tint(hsv(hsv[1], hsv[2] * (1 - desat), hsv[3]), lighten)
}

navy <- "#19486A"
pal <- list(
  ink   = navy,
  muted = tint(navy, 0.40),
  land  = tint(navy, 0.965),
  adm0  = tint(navy, 0.15),
  adm1  = tint(navy, 0.55),
  adm2  = tint(navy, 0.78),
  bar   = soften("#0A6EB4", desat = 0.35, lighten = 0.25)
)

facility_types <- tribble(
  ~type,                            ~colour,             ~size,
  "Hospital",                       soften("#C5192D"),   2.2,
  "Health centre",                  soften("#DDA63A"),   1.6,
  "Maternal & child health centre", soften("#0A6EB4"),   1.35,
  "Health post",                    soften("#3F7E44"),   0.95
)

font <- "Arial Narrow"

theme_day01 <- geosom_theme(base_size = 12, base_family = font) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, colour = pal$ink, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12.5, colour = pal$muted, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 9, colour = pal$muted, lineheight = 1.15, hjust = 0),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
    legend.title         = element_blank(),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 11.5, colour = pal$ink, margin = margin(r = 16)),
    legend.key.width     = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x     = unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.box.margin    = margin(0, 0, 6, -6),
    plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin          = margin(16, 18, 12, 18)
  )

## Data
admin0 <- get_admin_shape("admin0")
admin1 <- get_admin_shape("admin1")
admin2 <- get_admin_shape("admin2")

facilities_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axmedmaxamuud/test_datasets/main/data/who_health_facilities_somalia.csv"

facilities <- read_csv(facilities_url, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    type = case_match(
      facility_type,
      c("Hospital", "District Hospital", "Regional Hospital") ~ "Hospital",
      "Health Centre"                  ~ "Health centre",
      "Maternal & Child Health Centre" ~ "Maternal & child health centre",
      "Health Post"                    ~ "Health post"
    ) |> factor(levels = facility_types$type)
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_filter(admin0) |>
  st_join(select(admin1, admin1name), join = st_within)

```

```{r}
#| label: day01-map
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 9.375
#| fig-dpi: 150
#| dev: "ragg_png"
#| fig-alt: "Map of public health facilities in Somalia by type, with a bar chart of facilities per 100,000 people by region."

# Facilities per 100,000 people
coverage <- population_admin2_2026 %>%
  summarise(population = sum(population_total), .by = admin1_name) %>%
  rename(admin1name = admin1_name) %>%
  left_join(count(st_drop_geometry(facilities), admin1name, name = "facilities"),
            by = "admin1name") %>%
  mutate(
    facilities = replace_na(facilities, 0),
    per_100k   = facilities / population * 1e5
  )

national_rate <- sum(coverage$facilities) / sum(coverage$population) * 1e5

# Map
map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = admin0, fill = pal$land, colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = admin2, fill = NA, colour = pal$adm2, linewidth = 0.2, linetype = "22") +
  geom_sf(data = admin1, fill = NA, colour = pal$adm1, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = admin0, fill = NA, colour = pal$adm0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = arrange(facilities, desc(type)),
          aes(colour = type, size = type), shape = 16) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = deframe(select(facility_types, type, colour))) +
  scale_size_manual(values = deframe(select(facility_types, type, size)), guide = "none") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2.6))) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(40.8, 54.2), ylim = c(-1.9, 12.2), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = "Health Facility Coverage in Somalia",
    subtitle = sprintf("%s public health facilities across Somalia with %.1f health facilities for every 100,000 people.",
                       format(nrow(facilities), big.mark = ","), national_rate),
    caption  = paste(
      "#30DayMapChallenge 2026 | Day 1: Points",
      "Data: ©WHO Somalia health facilities (HDX, 2023)",
      "github.com/axmedmaxamuud/geosom",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_day01

# Chart: facilities per 100,000 people by region
chart <- ggplot(coverage, aes(per_100k, fct_reorder(admin1name, per_100k))) +
  geom_col(fill = pal$bar, width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", per_100k)),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 3, family = font, colour = pal$muted) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(title = "Public health facilities\nper 100,000 people") +
  theme_void(base_family = font) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 11.5, colour = pal$ink, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = pal$ink, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 4))
  )

# produce final map
day01 <- map +
  inset_element(chart, left = 0.665, bottom = 0.02, right = 0.99, top = 0.47, align_to = "panel")

day01
```


## Day 2: Streets of Mogadishu

This map shows the street network of Mogadishu using OpenStreetMap data. some of the well know junctions of KM4, Ex control Afgooye and Balcad are marked.


```{r}
#| label: day02-setup
#| include: false

## Packages ----
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(geosom)
library(ragg)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

## Palette ----
# WFP colours (WFP UI guide v1.0.0); lighter hues of them are allowed
wfp <- c(blue = "#0A6EB4", navy = "#19486A", aqua = "#26BDE2", yellow = "#F7B825",
         ochre = "#DDA63A", orange = "#FD6925")
shade <- \(col, amount, to = "white") colorRampPalette(c(col, to))(101)[round(amount * 100) + 1]

pal <- list(
  paper = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.94),   # page background, near white
  land  = wfp[["navy"]],                # the city
  sea   = wfp[["blue"]],                # Indian Ocean
  ring  = wfp[["navy"]],
  ink   = wfp[["navy"]],
  muted = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.45)
)

font <- "Arial Narrow"

## Road classes: colour and width by size ----
road_classes <- tribble(
  ~class,          ~osm,                                                        ~colour,                     ~width, ~alpha,
  "Main roads",    c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "trunk_link", "primary_link"), wfp[["yellow"]],          1.5,    1,
  "Secondary",     c("secondary", "secondary_link"),                            shade(wfp[["yellow"]], 0.45), 0.9,    1,
  "Tertiary",      c("tertiary", "tertiary_link"),                              "white",                     0.55,   0.9,
  "Local streets", c("residential", "unclassified", "living_street", "service", "pedestrian"),
                                                                                "white",                     0.18,   0.45
)
lookup <- road_classes |> select(class, osm) |> unnest(osm)

## Data ----
# Mogadishu streets from OpenStreetMap, stored on GitHub.
# The file is downloaded once to a temporary file, then read with sf.
streets_url  <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axmedmaxamuud/test_datasets/main/data/mogadishu_streets.gpkg"
streets_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
download.file(streets_url, streets_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

## Geometry: a full-bleed 4:5 frame around central Mogadishu ----
crs_utm <- 32638                                   # UTM 38N, metres
centre  <- st_sfc(st_point(c(45.318, 2.046)), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs_utm)
cx <- st_coordinates(centre)[1]
cy <- st_coordinates(centre)[2]

# 18 km wide x 22.5 km tall (4:5), set a little north so the city fills the frame
xlim  <- cx + c(-9000, 9000)
ylim  <- cy + c(-12500, 10000)
frame <- st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim[1], ymin = ylim[1], xmax = xlim[2], ymax = ylim[2]), crs = crs_utm) |>
  st_as_sfc()

streets <- st_read(streets_file, quiet = TRUE) |>
  inner_join(lookup, by = c("highway" = "osm")) |>
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = road_classes$class)) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  st_intersection(frame) |>
  arrange(desc(class))                             # main roads drawn last, on top

# geosom's coastline is drawn at country scale, so here it sits ~1 km out to sea.
# Refine it locally: land near the coast with no street nearby becomes sea.
somalia    <- get_admin_shape("admin0") |> st_transform(crs_utm) |> st_geometry() |> st_union()
land_raw   <- st_intersection(somalia, frame)
coastline  <- st_boundary(somalia) |> st_intersection(st_buffer(frame, 2000))    # the real coast only
coast_band <- st_buffer(coastline, 1500) |> st_intersection(land_raw)

# City footprint: 100 m grid cells that contain a street, smoothed (light on memory)
grid <- st_make_grid(st_buffer(frame, 500), cellsize = 100)
city <- grid[lengths(st_intersects(grid, streets)) > 0] |> st_union() |>
  st_buffer(250) |> st_buffer(-180) |> st_simplify(dTolerance = 40)

land <- st_difference(land_raw, st_difference(coast_band, city))
sea  <- st_difference(frame, land)

## Key junctions (coordinates provided by the author) ----
# nx / ny: label offset in metres; hjust: 0 = label to the right, 1 = to the left
junctions <- tribble(
  ~name,                 ~lat,         ~lon,          ~nx,   ~ny,   ~hjust,
  "KM4",                 2.031641448,  45.31066228,    350,  -450,  0,
  "Ex Control Afgooye",  2.045068388,  45.28266736,   -350,   450,  1,
  "Ex Control Balcad",   2.086576909,  45.36394565,    350,   350,  0
) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1], y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2])

## Title, legend and footnote positions (map units, metres) ----
spaced <- \(x) paste(strsplit(x, "")[[1]], collapse = " ")   # thin spaces between letters
W <- diff(xlim); H <- diff(ylim)

legend_items <- road_classes |>
  mutate(
    y  = ylim[1] + H * (0.20 - (row_number() - 1) * 0.032),
    x0 = xlim[1] + W * 0.70,
    x1 = xlim[1] + W * 0.76
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: day02-map
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 9.375
#| fig-dpi: 150
#| dev: "ragg_png"
#| fig-alt: "Map of Mogadishu's street network. Main roads are bold yellow, secondary roads pale yellow, tertiary roads white and local streets fine white lines. KM4, Ex Control Afgooye and Ex Control Balcad junctions are marked."

day02 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sea,  fill = pal$sea,  colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = pal$land, colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = streets, aes(colour = class, linewidth = class, alpha = class), lineend = "round") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = deframe(select(road_classes, class, colour)), guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = deframe(select(road_classes, class, width)), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = deframe(select(road_classes, class, alpha)), guide = "none") +

  # key junctions: white dot with a navy ring, name on a navy tab
  geom_point(data = junctions, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 3.6,
             fill = "white", colour = pal$land, stroke = 1.4) +
  geom_label(data = junctions, aes(x + nx, y + ny, label = name, hjust = hjust),
             family = font, size = 4.1, colour = "white", fill = pal$land,
             label.size = 0, label.r = unit(0, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.22, "lines")) +

  # title across the top, on a solid navy band
  annotate("rect", xmin = xlim[1], xmax = xlim[2], ymin = ylim[2] - H * 0.115, ymax = ylim[2],
           fill = pal$land) +
  annotate("text", x = cx, y = ylim[2] - H * 0.058, label = spaced("MOGADISHU"),
           family = font, fontface = "bold", size = 17, colour = "white") +

  # legend, bottom right over the sea: a road sample and its name
  annotate("segment", x = legend_items$x0, xend = legend_items$x1,
           y = legend_items$y, yend = legend_items$y,
           colour = legend_items$colour, linewidth = legend_items$width * 1.5,
           alpha = pmax(legend_items$alpha, 0.75), lineend = "round") +
  annotate("text", x = legend_items$x1 + W * 0.025, y = legend_items$y, label = legend_items$class,
           family = font, size = 4.2, colour = "white", hjust = 0) +

  # footnote, bottom left over the sea
  annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + W * 0.04, y = ylim[1] + H * 0.035,
           label = paste0("#30DayMapChallenge 2026  |  Day 2: Lines\n",
                          "Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)\n",
                          "github.com/axmedmaxamuud/geosom"),
           family = font, size = 3, colour = shade(pal$sea, 0.55), lineheight = 1.15,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0) +

  coord_sf(crs = crs_utm, datum = NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = pal$sea, colour = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

day02
```


## Day 3: Landcover of Riverine Areas in Somalia

The land cover of riverine areas in Somalia. only 3% of the 9.8 million hectors of land is farmed with river water while the bigest share of farms are rainfed. 

```{r}
#| label: day03b-setup
#| include: false

## Packages ----
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(geosom)
library(ragg)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)
options(timeout = 600)

## Palette ----
# WFP colours (WFP UI guide v1.0.0)
wfp <- c(blue = "#0A6EB4", navy = "#19486A", aqua = "#26BDE2", dark_green = "#3F7E44",
         lime = "#8AD220", yellow = "#F7B825", ochre = "#DDA63A", orange = "#FD6925",
         red = "#C5192D", dark_red = "#A21942", magenta = "#DD1367")
shade <- \(col, amount, to = "white") colorRampPalette(c(col, to))(101)[round(amount * 100) + 1]

pal <- list(
  land  = "white",                      
  sea   = shade(wfp[["blue"]], 0.86),
  line  = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.72),
  ink   = wfp[["navy"]],
  muted = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.40)
)
font <- "Arial Narrow"

## Land use classes, 
classes <- tribble(
  ~vocation,            ~class,                  ~colour,                          ~farmed,
  "IRRIGATED",          "Irrigated farms",       wfp[["blue"]],       TRUE,
  "MIXED WATER SUPPLY", "Irrigated and rainfed", wfp[["aqua"]],       TRUE,
  "POST FLOODING",      "Flood-recession farms", wfp[["orange"]],     TRUE,
  "RAINFED",            "Rainfed farms",         wfp[["yellow"]],     TRUE,
  "RANGELAND",          "Rangeland",             wfp[["lime"]],       FALSE,
  "WOODED VEGETATION",  "Bush and woodland",     wfp[["dark_green"]], FALSE,
  "OTHER",              "Bare soil, sand, towns and water", wfp[["ochre"]], FALSE
) |>
  mutate(class = fct_inorder(class))

## Data ----
crs_utm <- 32638                                    

# FAO SWALIM land cover and river lines, stored on GitHub.
# Each file is downloaded once to a temporary file, then read with sf.
github <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axmedmaxamuud/test_datasets/main/data/"
get_gpkg <- function(name) {
  file <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
  download.file(paste0(github, name, ".gpkg"), file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  file
}
landcover_file <- get_gpkg("landcover_riverine_2007")    # about 36 MB
rivers_file    <- get_gpkg("rivers_juba_shabelle")

landcover <- st_read(landcover_file, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>               # one stray non-polygon feature dropped
  left_join(classes, by = "vocation") |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 60, preserveTopology = TRUE)   # 1.9 million vertices is more than a map needs

# The rivers: FAO SWALIM's Juba and Shabelle lines (the land cover only maps the
# wider Juba channel, so the Shabelle would otherwise be missing)
rivers <- st_read(rivers_file, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 60)

admin0 <- get_admin_shape("admin0") |> st_transform(crs_utm)
admin1 <- get_admin_shape("admin1") |> st_transform(crs_utm)
rivers <- st_intersection(rivers, st_union(admin0))       

## Frame: the two valleys, from Belet Weyne down to Kismayo
bb   <- st_bbox(landcover)
cx   <- mean(bb[c("xmin", "xmax")]) + 15000
cy   <- mean(bb[c("ymin", "ymax")]) + 5000
H    <- 660000                                  
W    <- H * 0.8
xlim <- cx + c(-W, W) / 2
ylim <- cy + c(-H, H) / 2
frame <- st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim[1], ymin = ylim[1], xmax = xlim[2], ymax = ylim[2]), crs = crs_utm) |>
  st_as_sfc()

in_ocean <- st_sfc(st_point(c(45, 0.3)), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs_utm)
ocean <- st_difference(frame, st_union(admin0)) |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  (\(x) x[lengths(st_intersects(x, in_ocean)) > 0])()

## Region labels: small spaced capitals, set in the white part of each region ----
# For each region, find its largest open area (not covered by the land cover, not
# under the title) and put the name in the middle of it
spaced <- \(x) map_chr(x, \(s) paste(strsplit(s, "")[[1]], collapse = "\u2009"))

footprint  <- landcover |> st_simplify(dTolerance = 300) |> st_buffer(500) |> st_union() |> st_buffer(-500)
title_zone <- st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim[1], xmax = xlim[1] + W * 0.65, ymin = ylim[2] - H * 0.19, ymax = ylim[2]),
                      crs = crs_utm) |> st_as_sfc()

# Region boundaries as lines, cleared from the title area so the text sits on plain white.
# Somalia's own border is drawn in full, so it is never cut.
# The subtitle area: the border pauses there so it doesn't cross the words
subtitle_zone  <- st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim[1] + W * 0.03, xmax = xlim[1] + W * 0.51,
                            ymin = ylim[2] - H * 0.152, ymax = ylim[2] - H * 0.085), crs = crs_utm) |> st_as_sfc()
somalia_border <- admin0 |> st_union() |> st_boundary() |> st_difference(subtitle_zone)
admin_lines    <- admin1 |> st_boundary() |> st_union() |> st_difference(title_zone)

regions <- admin1 |>
  select(region = admin1name) |>
  filter(!region %in% c("Banadir", "Galgaduud")) |> 
  st_intersection(st_buffer(frame, -W * 0.08)) |> 
  st_difference(st_union(footprint, title_zone)) |>
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") |> st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) |>
  slice_max(area, n = 1, by = region) |>
  mutate(geometry = map(geometry, \(g) {                  
    inner <- st_buffer(st_sfc(g, crs = crs_utm), -12000)
    if (st_is_empty(inner)) inner <- st_buffer(st_sfc(g, crs = crs_utm), -3000)
    if (st_is_empty(inner)) inner <- st_sfc(g, crs = crs_utm)
    st_point_on_surface(inner)[[1]]
  }) |> st_sfc(crs = crs_utm)) |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1], y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2])

# Two names placed by hand: Middle Shabelle has no open ground in the frame (its
# name sits on the farmland), and Middle Juba's open strip is too narrow
by_hand <- tribble(
  ~region,            ~lon,   ~lat,
  "Middle Shabelle",  45.70,  2.55,
  "Middle Juba",      42.96,  1.29
) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1], y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]) |>
  st_drop_geometry()

regions <- regions |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(region, x, y) |>
  filter(!region %in% by_hand$region) |>
  bind_rows(by_hand) |>
  mutate(label = spaced(toupper(region)))

## River names, set letter by letter along each river's course
# Letters follow a smooth line drawn beside the river; widths come from the font
text_on_path <- function(label, lon, lat, size = 4.2, family = font, fontface = "bold.italic") {
  pts  <- st_sfc(map2(lon, lat, \(a, b) st_point(c(a, b))), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs_utm) |> st_coordinates()
  sm   <- spline(seq_along(pts[, 1]), pts[, 1], n = 400)$y |> cbind(spline(seq_along(pts[, 2]), pts[, 2], n = 400)$y)
  dist <- c(0, cumsum(sqrt(rowSums(diff(sm)^2))))
  pt   <- size * .pt                                         
  m_pt <- W / (7.5 * 72)                                     
  chars <- strsplit(label, "")[[1]]
  adv   <- systemfonts::shape_string(chars, family = family, size = pt,
                                     italic = grepl("italic", fontface), bold = grepl("bold", fontface))$metrics$width * m_pt
  adv   <- adv * 1.12                                        
  mid   <- (max(dist) - sum(adv)) / 2 + cumsum(adv) - adv / 2 
  at    <- \(v, d) approx(dist, v, d)$y
  tibble(
    label = chars,
    x     = at(sm[, 1], mid),
    y     = at(sm[, 2], mid),
    angle = atan2(at(sm[, 2], mid + 1000) - at(sm[, 2], mid - 1000),
                  at(sm[, 1], mid + 1000) - at(sm[, 1], mid - 1000)) * 180 / pi
  )
}

# Lines are drawn so the words read upwards, from the lower end of each stretch
juba_label     <- text_on_path("Juba River",     lon = c(42.73, 42.69, 42.68, 42.71), lat = c(2.75, 3.03, 3.31, 3.58))
shabelle_label <- text_on_path("Shabelle River", lon = c(45.93, 45.88, 45.84, 45.79), lat = c(2.98, 3.24, 3.50, 3.76))

## Numbers for the story ----
area <- landcover |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(hectares = sum(hectares), .by = c(class, colour, farmed)) |>
  arrange(class) |>
  mutate(share = hectares / sum(hectares))

total_ha  <- sum(area$hectares)
water_ha  <- sum(filter(area, class %in% c("Irrigated farms", "Irrigated and rainfed", "Flood-recession farms"))$hectares)
rainfed_s <- filter(area, class == "Rainfed farms")$share
wood_s    <- filter(area, class == "Bush and woodland")$share

## Legend: one bar split by area, laid over the sea (bottom right) ----
lx0 <- xlim[1] + W * 0.55
lx1 <- xlim[2] - W * 0.05
ly  <- ylim[1] + H * 0.285
legend_bar <- area |>
  mutate(x1 = lx0 + cumsum(share) * (lx1 - lx0), x0 = lag(x1, default = lx0))

legend_rows <- area |>
  mutate(
    y     = ly - H * 0.028 - (row_number() - 1) * H * 0.0215,
    label = sprintf("%s  %s%%", class, if_else(share < 0.01, "<1", as.character(round(share * 100))))
  )

## Places ----
towns <- tribble(
  ~town,          ~lon,   ~lat,   ~hjust,
  "Belet Weyne",  45.20,   4.74,  0,
  "Jowhar",       45.50,   2.78,  0,
  "Afgooye",      45.12,   2.14,  1,
  "Mogadishu",    45.34,   2.04,  0,
  "Marka",        44.77,   1.71,  0,
  "Luuq",         42.55,   3.80,  0,
  "Baardheere",   42.28,   2.34,  1,
  "Bu'aale",      42.58,   1.08,  0,
  "Jilib",        42.78,   0.49,  0,
  "Jamaame",      42.75,   0.07,  0,
  "Kismayo",      42.54,  -0.36,  1
) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1], y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2],
         nx = if_else(hjust == 0, 7000, -7000))
```


```{r}
#| label: day03b-map
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 9.375
#| fig-dpi: 150
#| dev: "ragg_png"
#| fig-alt: "Land cover map of the Juba and Shabelle river valleys in southern Somalia, 2007. Bush and woodland in dark green covers most of the valleys, with rainfed farms in yellow, rangeland in lime, and thin strips of irrigated and flood-recession farms in blue and orange along the two rivers. Region names, main towns and a legend of each land use's share of the area are shown."

day03b <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ocean, fill = pal$sea, colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = admin_lines, colour = pal$line, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = somalia_border, colour = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.55), linewidth = 0.7) +
  # land cover, no outlines so the patchwork of fields shows
  geom_sf(data = landcover, aes(fill = class), colour = NA) +
  # the rivers: a navy line inside a white casing, visible on every colour
  geom_sf(data = rivers, colour = "white", linewidth = 1.6, lineend = "round") +
  geom_sf(data = rivers, colour = wfp[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.7, lineend = "round") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = deframe(select(classes, class, colour)), guide = "none") +

  # towns
  geom_point(data = towns, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 1.9, fill = "white", colour = pal$ink, stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_label(data = towns, aes(x + nx, y, label = town, hjust = hjust),
             family = font, size = 3.4, colour = pal$ink, fill = alpha("white", 0.75),
             label.size = 0, label.r = unit(0.1, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines")) +
  # region names: small, spaced navy capitals
  geom_text(data = regions, aes(x, y, label = label),
            family = font, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", colour = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.35)) +
  # river names, curved along the rivers
  geom_text(data = bind_rows(juba_label, shabelle_label), aes(x, y, label = label, angle = angle),
            family = font, fontface = "bold.italic", size = 4.2, colour = "white") +

  # title block, top left over empty land
  annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + W * 0.04, y = ylim[2] - H * 0.035, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           label = "Riverine Landcover", family = font, fontface = "bold", size = 8.5, colour = pal$ink) +
  annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + W * 0.04, y = ylim[2] - H * 0.09, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, lineheight = 1.2,
           label = sprintf(paste0(
             "Land cover in Somalia's Juba and Shabelle River, 2007\n",
             "%.1f million hectares: %d%% bush and woodland, %d%% rainfed farms.\n",
             "Only %d%% is farmed with river water."),
             total_ha / 1e6, round(wood_s * 100), round(rainfed_s * 100), round(water_ha / total_ha * 100)),
           family = font, size = 3.6, colour = pal$ink) +

  # legend: area bar, then the classes
  annotate("text", x = lx0, y = ly + H * 0.022, hjust = 0, label = "Share of the mapped area",
           family = font, size = 3.6, colour = pal$ink, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = legend_bar$x0, xmax = legend_bar$x1, ymin = ly - H * 0.006, ymax = ly + H * 0.008,
           fill = legend_bar$colour, colour = NA) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = lx0, xmax = lx0 + W * 0.022, ymin = legend_rows$y - H * 0.0065,
           ymax = legend_rows$y + H * 0.0065, fill = legend_rows$colour) +
  annotate("text", x = lx0 + W * 0.035, y = legend_rows$y, hjust = 0, label = legend_rows$label,
           family = font, size = 3.4, colour = pal$ink) +

  # footnote, at the bottom right over the sea, with space below the legend
  annotate("text", x = lx0, y = ylim[1] + H * 0.018, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, lineheight = 1.15,
           label = paste0("#30DayMapChallenge 2026  |  Day 3: Polygons\n",
                          "Data: FAO SWALIM, Landcover of Riverine Areas (2007)\n\n"),
           family = font, size = 2.9, colour = pal$muted) +

  coord_sf(crs = crs_utm, datum = NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

day03b
```
